name: justai
description: JustAI public-interest AI observatory contracts and static release tooling

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:fast && pnpm run verify:full
scripts.lint:fast: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && python3 -m py_compile tools/source_intake.py tools/verify_monorepo.py tools/gcp_self_verify.py tools/multi_instance_self_verify.py apps/discovery/src/loop.py apps/platform/src/runtime.py apps/operations/src/recovery.py && node --check site/render.test.mjs
scripts.test:focused: cargo test --workspace && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test site/render.test.mjs
scripts.verify:contracts: cargo test --workspace && python3 tools/verify_monorepo.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run test:focused && python3 tools/verify_monorepo.py && node --check site/render.mjs && python3 tools/source_intake.py --help >/dev/null && python3 tools/independent_validate.py --help >/dev/null && python3 tools/publish_release.py --help >/dev/null
